sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Vacate the Premises is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "That whole health resort thing went massive, didn't it? Thing is, as I told you, I had business there with Ref, in those cellars. I used to think Ref took all the equipment outta there, but now it turns out there's still tons of tech still down there. So I figured, what's the harm in taking some of it? Nah, you don't have to bring me those TVs and cameras, don't worry. Those need careful inspection and good packing. I got my own people for that. But I can't just send them out there right now! They're good with tech, but they're dogshit with guns. If a real professional, wink-wink, would make it down there and chase all the other mercs out of there, then we'd be in business. So just when I thought of that, I remembered you, brother! You ready to help with a good cause? Obviously, if you do the job properly, I'll give you some goodies in return!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 24 PMC operatives inside The Labyrinth
Note: The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate any 36 targets in The Labyrinth instead.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +20,400 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.03
- 208,000 Roubles
  - 218,400 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 239,200 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Black)
- 1× Last Breath poster
"Good thing I asked you to do this. Alrighty then, I'll pass it on to my guys. If we're lucky, we'll be swimming in tech sales for a long time. Here's your share, Ragman always rewards good deeds!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to kill 24 PMСs in The Labyrinth.

Note: The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate any 36 targets in The Labyrinth instead.
